allow_coalescing.note: the MLP's fan-ins exceed one ODIN core's 127 logical inputs (256 rows, per-axon sign), and ODIN has no inter-core partial-sum transfer: the cell declares coalescing, a departure from the chip

cores.note: 64 ODIN cores: ODIN is one core, and the MNIST cell needs a pool of them

firing_granularity.note: the cell's subtractive reset needs the per-cycle compare (the per-event law requires the zero reset, the derivation's rule): a departure from ODIN's per-event compare (Fig. 3, lif_neuron_state.v:44, the odin description's statement)

membrane_bits.note: the per-cycle compare runs the unbounded accumulator (an unsigned 8-bit register under the per-cycle compare is refused by the derivation's parity rule): a departure from ODIN's 8-bit saturating membrane (frenkel2019odin Section II-C, lif_neuron_state.v:55-64, the odin description's statement)

firing_mode.note: the tier-0 cell runs the framework's subtractive reset (Default), a departure from ODIN's reset to zero (src/LIF_neuron_blocks/lif_neuron_state.v:46, the odin description's statement)

thresholding_mode.note: the tier-0 cell fires above the threshold (strict '<'), a departure from ODIN's threshold at equality (lif_neuron_state.v:44, the odin description's statement)
